title: astracantha bactriana
intro: Astracantha bactriana, commonly known as Astragalus, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the Fabaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects. Astragalus is said to have therapeutic actions such as enhancing the body's immune system, reducing stress, and promoting cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of Astragalus include flavonoids, saponins, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
